subject.title: Add sms.read command and SMS as a messaging channel

question: Should OpenClaw add Android-device SMS read/inbound/reply as a first-class Android-node channel, or keep first-class SMS messaging on the existing Twilio `sms` plugin while Android exposes only explicitly allowed node tools?
rationale: This crosses local SMS content access, phone-number identity, carrier-send authority, and the existing Twilio `channels.sms` product surface, which automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Design device SMS explicitly
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define the Android-node channel boundary, opt-in policy, config names, and proof bar before implementation.

options.title: Narrow to sms.read only
options.body: Split the work so maintainers can consider a read-only Android invoke command separately from inbound channel/reply authority.

options.title: Use Twilio SMS only
options.body: Close this direction if maintainers decide that first-class SMS messaging should remain provider-hosted through the existing Twilio plugin.

recommendation.title: Design device SMS explicitly
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define the Android-node channel boundary, opt-in policy, config names, and proof bar before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans Android app capabilities and existing SMS command policy, and this account is the clearest Android routing owner from CONTRIBUTING.md and merged SMS history.
